what: NDTI of no-green pixels, NDVI and no-green share of clear WorldCover-2021 cropland pixels (about 60 m) per 0.005-degree cell, Cruz Alta (IBGE 4306106), every HLS v2.0 scene of the window with >= 30% of the cropland clear
cell_key: i_j with i = floor((lat - origin_lat) / cell_deg), j = floor((lon - origin_lon) / cell_deg)
value: per scene: [1000 * median NDTI of the no-green pixels (NDVI < 0.30; null if fewer than 6), 1000 * median NDVI of all clear cropland pixels, % of clear cropland pixels that are no-green]; null where the cell was cloudy or had too few clear cropland pixels
attribution: NASA HLS v2.0 (LP DAAC; doi:10.5067/HLS/HLSS30.002, 10.5067/HLS/HLSL30.002) via Microsoft Planetary Computer; ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 (CC BY 4.0); IBGE municipal mesh 2022
caveat: a cell median mixes fields; it is not the pixel under a 15 m rope
